decision: Opt-in host-provisioned per-subject scopes passed shared ASGI tests. Two subjects sharing run ID 101 received their respective counts and references. Context search and handoff matched their scope. Cross-snapshot fetch and unknown subject were rejected. All 17 locally selected receipt and gateway tests passed.
limits: Synthetic introspection and local in-process HTTP transport. Two separate read-only snapshots. This covers the programmatic host builder; real issuer, tenant policy, external transport and live deployment remain outstanding.
next_actions: Verify the learning service with an owner-provisioned institutional pilot, approved data policy and restart exercise.
Exercise the opt-in subject mapping with operator-provisioned pilot snapshots and issuer. Verify identity revocation and refreshed catalogue behavior across requests.
Test the training-parent planner with distinct versioned coder adapters. Record measured calls and cost, and use a fresh holdout to decide whether any proposal improves behavior.
Evaluate an additional instrument dataset with documented unit conventions. Recheck missing values and timestamp precision across scientific data interchange.
Evaluate a selector that estimates interpolation error for mesh alternatives, including both uniform orientations. Freeze its proxy and test on new geometries with uncertain amplitude before scoring.
